Senior Revenue Operations Analyst

We are seeking a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst to support our go-to-market
teams at a B2B SaaS company serving healthcare providers. Reporting to the
Director of Revenue Operations, you will own pipeline reporting and forecasting
accuracy across sales and customer success.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain pipeline and forecast reporting in Salesforce
- Manage territory and quota planning cycles each quarter
- Analyze funnel conversion and deliver monthly insights to leadership
- Partner with Marketing on lead routing and attribution
- Maintain data hygiene standards across Salesforce and HubSpot

Requirements:
- 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Analytics
- Advanced Salesforce reporting experience, including custom report types
- Strong SQL skills for querying warehouse data
- Experience with a BI tool such as Tableau or Looker
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience
- Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
- Hybrid schedule, three days per week onsite in Austin, TX

Preferred:
- Healthcare or life sciences industry experience
- Experience with Snowflake
- Salesforce Administrator certification
